implementation_strategy: Execute the preregistered paired confirmatory study using the hosted_netops_gvr_v1 adapter capabilities only: (1) use one shared initial generation per intent (direct_configuration_generation_v1) across conditions; (2) apply deterministic automated syntax and policy validator in pre-apply read-only sandbox; (3) for validator-rejected candidates, issue at most one deterministic LLM repair call (generate_validate_repair_v1) per intent; (4) apply CLI to sandbox replicas and run deterministic probes (reachability/policy checks); (5) all scoring and failure-flagging performed by adapter-provided deterministic scorers; (6) preserve full logs, hashes, RNG seed=42, and emulator snapshots. No RAG, no human adjudication, no local GPUs.
public_resources: Public/synthetic intent corpus and mapping templates (manifest recorded in execution_manifest); three sandbox topology recipes assembled from public topology examples and public device images (links in execution_manifest); adapter-provided deterministic validator and scorer implementations (recorded in execution_manifest).
model_and_version_plan: gpt-5-mini via openai_responses endpoint (fixed for all runs; model_name=model_version=gpt-5-mini).
task_manifest_strategy: Preassemble 400 unique intents from the public/synthetic intent corpus with vendor/change-type stratification as preregistered (VendorA:134, VendorB:133, VendorC:133; ACL=140, Routing=140, Monitoring=120). Manifest stored as JSON in execution_manifest with hashes and public-source references.
transformation_manifest_strategy: Baseline: direct_configuration_generation_v1 — templated prompts produce vendor-specific CLI. Guarded: generate_validate_repair_v1 — deterministic validator (syntax + policy invariants) run in read-only sandbox; on validator-fail, issue single deterministic repair call to same hosted model; re-validate candidate deterministically. All transformations implemented with adapter-allowed primitives only.
randomisation_plan: Within each paired intent, randomise application order (Direct‑apply vs Guarded first) using fixed RNG seed 42; seed recorded in execution_manifest. Pairing and stratification fixed per preregistration.
caching_plan: Cache emulator snapshots and deterministic validator binaries; no caching of model responses except storing full response hashes for nondeterminism detection. Retrieval not used.
failure_recovery_plan: On transient emulator/API failure: automated retry up to 2 times; persistent infrastructure failures → mark pairwise exclusion (exclude both condition runs for that intent) as preregistered; all exclusions logged. Model-provider transient errors counted as retryable; deterministic hash differences recorded as nondeterminism covariate.
result_schema: paired_binary_episode_v1: per-intent record includes intent_id, vendor, change_type, baseline_candidate_hash, guarded_candidate_hash, validator_status (pass/reject), repair_attempted (yes/no), binary_failure_flag_baseline (0/1), binary_failure_flag_guarded (0/1), outage_duration_seconds (if failure), rollback_flag (0/1), telemetry_snapshots, model_response_hashes, RNG_seed, execution_batch_id, timestamps.
estimated_compute_notes: Totals: 400 unique intents × one shared initial generation call per intent = 400 baseline model calls. At most one deterministic repair call per intent → worst-case 400 additional calls → maximum_model_calls = 400×2 = 800. Expected repair rate assumed ~50% → estimated_model_calls = 400 + 0.5×400 = 600 (selected estimate). All calls use hosted API (gpt-5-mini); no local GPU. Estimated token usage: assume average response ≤300 tokens; 600 calls × 300 tokens = 180,000 response tokens (plus prompt tokens); within adapter and capability manifest limits. All totals computed and recorded in execution_manifest; arithmetic derivation and per-batch breakdown recorded there.
